title: NeloTraders! Entusiastas em Trading e Investimentos - Porto Alegre/RS
description:
Se o título da vaga despertou o seu interesse, é bem provável que você já conheça a Nelogica e os nossos produtos, né?

Somos uma investech que atua no desenvolvimento de soluções tecnológicas de alta performance para o mercado financeiro. Em nosso portfólio, temos produtos que levam acesso à informação em tempo real e disponibilizam ferramentas para análise e negociação tanto na bolsa de valores brasileira (B³), quanto no mercado de criptomoedas e outras bolsas de negociação global. Além disso, temos um extenso portfólio de soluções institucionais que atendem os principais players do mercado de investimentos e somos uma referência no segmento.

Hoje dominamos o mercado de plataformas para trading e com todas as nossas soluções, atingimos +2 milhões de usuários! Por isso, desafios por aqui não faltam e temos muitas oportunidades em aberto, nas mais diversas frentes de atuação com base em São Paulo/SP.

Se você se identifica com o mercado financeiro, já conhece o Profit, Vector, AlgoTools, Comdinheiro ou outro dos nossos produtos, já fez operações de trading ou algo parecido… o que acha de fazer parte do time Nelogica e transformar o futuro do mercado financeiro com a gente? Se inscreva por aqui!

Que tipos de atuação um apaixonado por mercado financeiro pode ter aqui no time? São inúmeras as possibilidades, mas algumas das principais, são:

  • Marketing;
  • Relacionamento;
  • Vendas.

E claro, estamos sempre abrindo novas oportunidades! Nosso time irá analisar a sua candidatura e rolando uma identificação, entraremos em contato para entendermos o seu momento de carreira e avaliarmos posições aderentes.

Consideramos como diferenciais experiências complementares além da atuação profissional, como o envolvimento acadêmico (PETs, mentorias, cursos, competições etc), ou envolvimento em comunidades de sua área de atuação, trabalho voluntário entre outros.

title: Business Development Representative (BDR)
description:
A Namoa Digital é uma empresa especializada no desenvolvimento de soluções SaaS voltadas para a gestão de manutenção de ativos industriais e serviços de facilities. Nosso software atua de forma integrada como um satélite do ERP, automatizando processos operacionais e elevando o nível de eficiência, qualidade e controle das operações.   • Experiência prévia em BDR, SDR Outbound, Inside Sales ou prospecção comercial;
  • Perfil hunter, com conforto em cold call, cold email e LinkedIn;
  • Excelente comunicação verbal e escrita;
  • Experiência com ferramentas de prospecção como Ramper (ou similares);
  • Vivência com CRM, preferencialmente Pipedrive;
  • Organização, disciplina e foco em metas;

Benefícios

  • Vale Transporte
  • Assistência Médica
  • Plano de Carreira

title: Data Pipeline Engineer
description:
About YipitData:

YipitData is the market-leading data and analytics firm. We analyze billions of data points every day to provide accurate, detailed insights across industries, including consumer brands, technology, software, and healthcare.

Our insights team uses proprietary technology to identify, license, clean, and analyze the data that many of the world’s largest investment funds and corporations depend on. We raised $475M from The Carlyle Group at a valuation over $1B, further accelerating our growth and market impact.

We have been recognized multiple times as one of Inc’s Best Workplaces. As a fast-growing company backed by The Carlyle Group and Norwest Venture Partners, YipitData is driven by a people-first culture rooted in mastery, ownership, and transparency.

With offices in New York, Austin, Miami, Denver, Mountain View, Seattle, Hong Kong, Shanghai, Beijing, Guangzhou, and Singapore, we continue to expand our reach and impact across global markets.

Why You Should Apply NOW:

We are seeking a highly skilled Data Pipeline Engineer to join our dynamic Data Engineering team. The ideal candidate possesses 4+ years of data engineering experience. An excellent candidate should have a solid understanding of Spark, SQL, and data pipeline experience. This individual will play a crucial role in supporting our strategic pipelines and optimizing for reliability, efficiency, and performance.

Hired individuals will play a crucial role in helping to shape our ETL strategy and be part of a rapidly growing team. In this role, you will be responsible for researching, planning, and implementing best practices that optimize data pipeline performance and reliability across our organization. You will work cross-functionally with all of our product teams to ensure smooth, efficient, and scalable pipelines. This position is ideal for someone who loves tackling complex technical challenges, enjoys hands-on problem-solving, and loves the fast-paced environment where they can make a big impact.

As Our Data Engineer, You Will:

  • Report directly to the Director of Data Engineering, who will provide significant, hands-on training on cutting-edge data tools and techniques.
  • Build end-to-end data pipelines.
  • Help with setting best practices for our data modeling and pipeline builds.
  • Create documentation, architecture diagrams, and other training materials for analysts.
  • Become an expert at solving complex data pipeline issues using PySpark and SQL.
  • Collaborate with stakeholders to incorporate business logic into our central pipelines.
  • Deeply learn Databricks, Airflow, and other ETL tooling.

You Are Likely To Succeed If:

  • You hold a Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, STEM, or a related technical discipline.
  • You have 4+ years of experience as a Data Engineer, or in other technical functions.
  • You are comfortable working with large-scale datasets using PySpark or Pandas .
  • You have a great understanding of working with data, orchestration tools, and data pipelines.
  • You understand business needs and the rationale behind different data ingestion and delivery strategies.
  • You are eager to constantly learn new technologies.
  • You are a self-starter who enjoys working with both internal and external stakeholders.
  • You have exceptional verbal and written communication skills.
  • Nice to have: Experience with Kubernetes, Docker, or equivalent.

What We Offer:

  • Flexible PTO for any reason, including sick days (no specified limits)
  • Flexible work schedule
  • Personal laptop
  • Health and wellness package
  • Remote work

Candidates must have primary residency (and be physically located) in the country of hire (AKA Brazil) in order to be considered for the position. If hired, the worker must maintain primary residency in the country of hire in order to be eligible for employment.

We are committed to equal employment opportunity regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, marital status, disability, gender, gender identity or expression, or veteran status. We are proud to be an equal-opportunity employer.

description:
Senior Motion Designer (with UX/UI)

Location : Remote (LATAM preferred)

Engagement : Part-time Contractor

Duration : 4 to 6 weeks (possibility of extension)

Schedule : 15 to 20 hours per week (or full-time for two sprints)

About the Role

We’re looking for a Motion Designer with strong expertise in UX/UI to elevate our product experience through animation, micro-interactions, and motion-driven storytelling. You’ll craft intuitive interfaces, define motion principles for our design system, and design flows that feel smooth, modern, and expressive.

This engagement is part of a larger product initiative, and strong performance may lead to future design phases.

We’re seeking someone detail-oriented, proactive, and comfortable collaborating with product, engineering, and leadership in a remote, fast-paced environment.

Responsibilities
  • Create 2D and 3D animations, parallax, or holographic-inspired elements, transitions, micro-interactions, banners, and Lottie or Framer Motion-ready assets
  • Design intuitive, accessible UI and UX flows enriched with clean, purposeful motion
  • Build or refine a lightweight design system in Figma, including components, tokens, motion states, and documentation
  • Propose tasteful animation patterns that enhance usability rather than distract
  • Ensure all motion follows accessibility best practices (reduced motion, contrast, timing, cognitive load)
  • Deliver final assets with implementation notes for engineering teams
  • Collaborate closely with product to iterate quickly based on feedback
Requirements
  • 4, or more, years of experience as a Motion Designer with strong knowledge in UI/UX design
  • Proficiency with animation tools such as After Effects, Lottie, Rive, or Framer Motion
  • Knowledge of Spline, Blender, or other 3D prototyping tools
  • Expert-level Figma skills
  • Portfolio demonstrating motion-first interfaces, refined UI, and strong UX thinking
  • Ability to articulate design decisions clearly and collaborate efficiently
  • Advanced English for communication with international teams
Nice to Have
  • Experience building or maintaining design systems at scale
  • Familiarity with front-end animation frameworks (React, Framer Motion, CSS transitions)
  • Previous work in agile or fast-paced product teams
Why Join

Your work will directly shape how users experience motion in our product. This is a highly visible project with room for creativity and experimentation. You’ll join a small, focused remote team that values craft, clarity, and smart design, and there’s a strong chance for future collaboration as the product expands.

If you love designing beautiful, usable interfaces combined with thoughtful motion and interaction design, this role is a great fit.

title: Logistics & 3PL Operations Specialist

About us

OPPO was founded in 2004 and is one of the global leaders in smart device innovation.

Our footprint covers more than 70 countries and regions , supported by over 300,000 sales outlets and 3,300 official service centers. We employ more than 40,000 dedicated professionals focused on creating a better life for customers worldwide through smarter products and services.

  • Ensure full regulatory compliance by maintaining flawless consistency between physical goods, information systems, and complex Brazilian tax documentation (NF-e, CT-e, MDF-e, etc.).

3. Project Management & Global Interface

  • Independently execute and drive key strategic logistics projects (e.g., major WMS/ERP system rollouts, warehouse network expansion) from planning through implementation.
  • Interface directly with the local Chinese team and Global Headquarters to align local operations with global supply chain strategy, acting as the primary subject matter expert in Brazil.

Requirements

  • Bachelor’s degree or higher in Accounting, Logistics, Supply Chain Management, or a related technical field.
  • Advanced English is mandatory (daily use).
  • Chinese is desirable.
  • 5+ years of progressive, hands-on experience in Warehouse Management, 3PL Operations, or Logistics roles, with a proven track record of driving process ownership and high-impact results.
  • Demonstrated strategic thinking , exceptional communication, and proven ability to operate with high autonomy and strong results-orientation.

Technical Expertise

  • Expert-level mastery of Brazilian logistics and tax legislation (NF-e, CT-e, MDF-e, ICMS).
  • Advanced proficiency in WMS, TMS, and integrated ERP systems.
  • Demonstrated deep experience in managing and controlling high-volume, serialized inventory (IMEI/serial numbers).

title: Data Engineer
description:
Job Summary:

  • We are seeking a Data Engineer to enhance the resilience and operational stability of our data pipelines, from factory floor to cloud repositories. This critical role will focus on building robust monitoring and support systems, and on accelerating our ability to understand and resolve system and pipeline breakdowns

Responsibilities:

  • Design, develop, and integrate production support technologies and systems to improve data pipeline reliability.
  • Proactively identify vulnerabilities and implement systemic process oriented solutions to enhance pipeline resilience.
  • Develop and apply advanced analytics for proactive pipeline monitoring, anomaly detection, and performance optimization.
  • Conduct in-depth statistical analysis of pipeline performance, incident data, and root causes to drive continuous improvement.
  • Prepare and maintain comprehensive reports and dashboards with key performance indicators (KPIs) for measuring system and pipeline resiliency.
  • Collaborate with global team of data analysts, engineers, and leaders to rapidly troubleshoot and resolve data pipeline issues.
  • Interface with corporate areas, preparing technical documentation, reports, and presentations on pipeline health and improvements.
  • Maintain accurate and up-to-date documentation for systems, processes, and troubleshooting guides.
  • Assist in meeting data environment governance requirements, specifically related to pipeline data quality and integrity.

Knowledge and Technical Competencies:

  • Soft skills: Organized, proactive, curious, sense of urgency and prioritization, and a strong feeling of ownership.

Technical expertise:

  • Proven experience in systems support, data pipelines, database reliability engineering, and IT production support.
  • Strong background in designing and implementing monitoring, alerting, and logging solutions.
  • Proficiency with cloud platforms, specifically Google Cloud Platform (GCP).
  • Experience with industrial data historians (e.g., OSI Soft PI) and API data extraction.

Experience:

  • Background: Degree in Engineering or Computer Science.

Technical Skills:

  • Proficiency in SQL (queries) and a scripting language (e.g., Python) for data analysis and automation.
  • Hands-on experience with GCP data technologies (e.g., BigQuery, Dataflow) and monitoring tools (e.g., Grafana, Cloud Monitoring).
  • Familiarity with business intelligence tools (e.g., Looker, Power BI, Tableau) for dashboarding.
  • Desirable: Knowledge of process industry KPIs. Familiarity with data governance platforms (e.g., Collibra) and data transformation tools (e.g., Dataform).
  • Multilingual English/Spanish/Portuguese would be a plus
  • Experience with Production Support would be a plus

description:

Nossa equipe de 15 mil colaboradores está sempre a mil, trazendo novas ideias e inovações. Desde que abrimos nossa capital em 2021, aceleramos nossa missão de transformar vidas com soluções de fitness e saúde.

Temos várias marcas no nosso portfólio, como Bio Ritmo, Smart Fit, Race Bootcamp, Vidya Studio, Jab House, Tonus Gym, One Pilates, Velocity, Kore TotalPass e Nation CT. Além disso, oferecemos produtos digitais como Queima Diária, Smart Fit Nutri e Smart Fit Coach. Estamos sempre procurando novas formas de integrar tecnologia e inovação para ajudar você a ter um estilo de vida mais ativo e saudável. E aí, topa o desafio junto com a gente?

O que nos move todos os dias?

Somos parte da mudança, transformando o cenário e trazendo mais qualidade para a vida de quem tá junto com a gente. Cada gotinha de suor é uma prova do nosso compromisso em inspirar e motivar todo mundo que quer uma vida mais ativa e saudável. A cada dia, começamos nossa jornada com aquecimento total, prontos para alcançar novos objetivos e viver o máximo.

O Engenheiro de Software Pleno PJ (Ruby on Rails) será responsável por:

1. Desenvolvimento e Entrega Técnica

  • Construção da API Core: Desenvolver e manter endpoints RESTful eficientes utilizando Ruby on Rails para suportar as aplicações Web e Mobile.
  • Escrita de Testes Automatizados: Garantir a estabilidade do sistema através de testes de integração e unitários (RSpec), utilizando VCR e WebMock para garantir que as dependências externas não atrasem o pipeline.
  • Otimização de Performance: Garantir que a API seja rápida e escalável, aplicando boas práticas de banco de dados (PostgreSQL) e evitando gargalos de processamento.

2. Integração e Homologação (Foco em Qualidade)

  • Validação de Integração: Testar e homologar ativamente as interações da API com o desenvolvimento Front-end (Web e Mobile), garantindo que os dados trafegados estejam corretos e performáticos.
  • Garantia de Eficiência: Assegurar a máxima qualidade no processo de integração, antecipando falhas de contrato de dados e garantindo que as funcionalidades atendam aos requisitos de UI/UX de ambos os clientes.
  • Definição de Contratos: Colaborar no desenho técnico prévio dos endpoints para garantir que o time de Front-end tenha mocks funcionais e especificações claras, minimizando o retrabalho.

3. Colaboração e Alinhamento

  • Gestão de Bloqueios: Atuar de forma proativa para identificar e comunicar impedimentos técnicos que possam impactar o cronograma de 3 meses.
  • Code Review: Participar de revisões de código focadas em manter o padrão de qualidade da equipe e a consistência do "Rails Way".

4. Aprendizado e Melhoria Contínua

  • Evolução Profissional: Manter-se atualizado com as novas versões do Ruby e do Rails, trazendo as melhores práticas de segurança e arquitetura para o projeto a longo prazo.
  • Aprimoramento de Processos: Analisar constantemente o ciclo de desenvolvimento e propor melhorias que tornem o fluxo de deploy e a integração com o front-end mais ágeis.

5. Documentação e Sustentabilidade

  • Documentação Técnica: Manter uma documentação clara e atualizada da API (ex: Swagger/OpenAPI) para servir como fonte única de verdade para os times de consumo.
  • Manutenibilidade: Equilibrar o pragmatismo da entrega rápida com a saúde do código, garantindo uma base sólida para a evolução permanente do produto.

Itens essenciais que não podem faltar no seu kit:

  • Ruby on Rails (Modo API): Domínio profundo do framework, priorizando o "Rails Way" e o uso de scaffolding eficiente para velocidade de entrega.
  • Design de API RESTful: Experiência em estruturar endpoints que atendam simultaneamente Web e Mobile (JSON, paginação, versionamento).
  • Testes e Mocking (RSpec): Domínio de VCR e WebMock para simular interações externas de forma determinística, garantindo uma suíte de testes rápida e confiável.
  • Modelagem de Dados: Experiência com PostgreSQL e uso eficiente de Active Record (evitando o problema de N+1).
  • Autenticação e Segurança: Implementação prática de JWT ou Devise Token Auth.
  • Pragmatismo e Foco: Foco em resolver o problema de negócio com a solução mais simples e direta, evitando "overengineering".
  • Comunicação Proativa e Colaboração: Habilidade de alinhar contratos de API antecipadamente com os times de Front-end e Mobile para evitar bloqueios e garantir que a integração seja fluida.
  • Antecipação de Riscos (Atitude Dono): Capacidade de identificar gargalos ou requisitos ambíguos precocemente, levantando a mão e propondo soluções para evitar retrabalhos.
  • Trabalho em Equipe: Mentalidade colaborativa, compartilhando conhecimento e garantindo que o código seja legível e mantível para o restante do time.
  • Autonomia: Capacidade de tomar decisões técnicas alinhadas às convenções do Rails sem necessidade de microgerenciamento.

Diferencial (IA): Uso de ferramentas como GitHub Copilot ou Cursor para acelerar a escrita de código e geração de mocks de dados.

title: Senior Business Analyst
description:
Job Title: ITS Business Analyst (Analytics)

Location: São Paulo, Brazil

Duration: 18 weeks (Independant Contractor) without benefits

Work Model: Remote

Job Summary

We are seeking a highly skilled ITS Business Analyst (Analytics) to support a critical analytics and data-platform transformation initiative. The ideal candidate will bring 5–7 years of business analysis experience , strong SQL expertise , and hands-on exposure to cloud-based analytics environments .

This role will play a key part in application rationalization and data migration efforts , including the transition from SAP S/4HANA to Snowflake . You will assess current-state analytics solutions, identify data gaps, and support the rebuilding and repointing of dashboards and reports to the future-state data platform.

Agile/Scrum experience is preferred, though Waterfall experience is acceptable .

Key Responsibilities

  • Partner with business stakeholders to gather, document, and analyze requirements for analytics and reporting solutions.
  • Review existing analytics applications and support application rationalization initiatives.
  • Assess current-state SAP S/4HANA/HANA data sources and identify future-state data gaps as systems migrate to Snowflake .
  • Support the repointing and rebuilding of dashboards and reports to new cloud data sources.
  • Translate business needs into clear data, reporting, and KPI requirements .
  • Work closely with data engineers, architects, and analytics teams to ensure accurate and timely delivery.
  • Develop and maintain dashboards and visualizations using Power BI, Tableau, or Looker .
  • Perform day-to-day SQL analysis to validate data, investigate issues, and support insights.
  • Create user stories, functional specifications, and process flows for analytics initiatives.
  • Facilitate workshops and working sessions to understand business processes and identify optimization opportunities.
  • Monitor KPIs and performance metrics to measure the success of analytics solutions.
  • Act as a liaison between business and technical teams to ensure alignment and clarity.
  • Support data governance practices to ensure data quality, consistency, and reliability.

Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in Business, Information Systems, Data Analytics, or a related field.
  • 5–7 years of experience as a Business Analyst, preferably in analytics or data-driven environments.
  • Strong SQL proficiency with hands-on experience querying and validating data.
  • Experience working with cloud platforms and data warehouses (Azure and/or Snowflake preferred).
  • Experience supporting analytics projects with an understanding of data modeling concepts (hands-on modeling not required).
  • Excellent communication, documentation, and stakeholder management skills.
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving abilities.
  • Familiarity with Agile/Scrum methodologies (Waterfall experience acceptable).

Preferred Skills

  • Experience with data modeling and ETL concepts .
  • Exposure to SAP S/4HANA or HANA-based reporting environments .
  • Knowledge of statistical analysis or machine learning concepts.
  • Business Analysis certifications such as CBAP, PMI-PBA , or similar.
  • Prior experience supporting large-scale data platform migrations .

title: Senior Data Scientist
description:
About Credix

Credix is a FinTech company dedicated to growing businesses in Latin America. Building on our expertise, we now focus on providing a tailored Buy Now, Pay Later (BNPL) solution for B2B transactions in Brazil with our platform, CrediPay. CrediPay is created to help business grow their sales and improve their cashflow efficiency through seamless and risk-free credit offering. Sellers offer their buyers flexible payment terms at an attractive price point and receive upfront payments. We manage and protect our clients from any credit & fraud risk, letting them focus only on what matters: increased sales and profitability.

Why choose Credix?

  • Become part of a forward-thinking start-up where boldness and a commitment to excellence are paramount, and your personal and professional development is at the forefront.
  • Work alongside a dedicated team of bright individuals driven by an Olympian mindset to excel in every aspect of our operations. Together, we aim to build with velocity, utilizing innovative embedded finance strategies to expand business operations in Latin America.
  • Experience a close and supportive work atmosphere where collaboration thrives, wise judgment guides our decisions, and you can learn, grow, and take on meaningful responsibilities.

About the job

We’re looking for a  Senior Data Scientist to join our Risk & Collections team. You’ll operate with high autonomy, own critical problem areas, and deliver value that moves the needle - from credit performance to capital efficiency. This isn’t a research role. You’ll work side-by-side with engineering, product, and operations to deploy models, run experiments, and improve the core systems that decide:

  • Who gets funded
  • How and when we collect
  • Where we allocate risk capital

You’ll report to the Head of Risk and collaborate closely with our data science and engineering team. You’ll work across the entire risk lifecycle - from first impression to final repayment - applying data science to maximize portfolio performance and capital efficiency. Your focus:  deliver models and systems that make better decisions, earlier.

Specifically, you will:

  • Model borrower risk : Build and refine probability-of-default (PD) and loss-given-default (LGD) models to inform underwriting and exposure sizing.
  • Detect and prevent fraud : Develop fraud signals and real-time scoring logic to flag suspicious behaviors - from application spoofing to behavioral anomalies post-purchase.
  • Prioritize recovery actions : Predict repayment propensity and optimize collections targeting - so we know  who to contact,  how , and  when .
  • Design experiments : Run tests across channels, messages, and strategies - not for learning’s sake, but to improve recovery, reduce loss, or increase throughput.
  • Deploy your work : Work closely with engineering to embed models and logic into our core credit and collections systems.
  • Create leverage : Equip the Risk, Credit, and Ops teams with tools, insights, and automation that scale smarter decisions.

What We’re Looking For

  • 5+ years of experience applying data science to business-critical problems.
  • Strong command of  SQL ,  Python , and the practical use of ML techniques (e.g., classification, uplift modeling, time series, or embeddings).
  • Experience deploying models in production - including versioning, validation, and post-deployment monitoring.
  • Comfort working autonomously with a high bar for quality and impact.
  • Experience working with product or engineering teams to embed model logic into live systems.
  • Solid understanding of business economics: marginal value, yield, CAC/LTV, or credit-related KPIs.

Nice to have:

  • Background in lending, collections, or credit analytics.
  • Experience with experimentation frameworks or causal inference.
  • Exposure to NLP or classification techniques (e.g., message quality prediction).

Languages:

  • Fluent in Portuguese and English (written and verbal).

What we offer

Collaboration and team spirit thrive best in an in-office environment. Our office provides a vibrant and engaging workspace where team members can connect, innovate, and grow. With access to our offices in Sao Paulo, you’ll immerse yourself in a culture of innovation and collaboration.

But that’s just the beginning - here’s what else we offer:

  • A culture of learning and experimentation: where you are encouraged to explore new ideas and technologies
  • Competitive salary package: Your hard work deserves recognition, and we ensure you’re well-rewarded for your contributions.
  • Equity stock options plan: Be a part of our journey towards success and share in the rewards.
  • Paid holidays: Enjoy the flexibility to recharge and rejuvenate
  • Off-sites: Awesome team building, unforgettable memories, and adventures ensured during our team off-sites.

title: Pessoa Coordenadora de Qualidade
description:
ALLOS é uma marca com uma forte herança. São cerca de 50 anos de experiência, transformando o mercado no Brasil. Somos referência em excelência e inovação, com a qualidade e confiança que faz parte da nossa história.

A nova marca surgiu pronta para o futuro, a partir da fusão entre a Aliansce Sonae e a brMalls, em 2023. Mas, essa trajetória começou bem antes.

Tudo começou com a Aliansce, que inaugurou o primeiro shopping da região Nordeste e o segundo do Brasil em 1975. Em 2019, a fusão entre a Aliansce e a Sonae Sierra deu origem à Aliansce Sonae, tornando-se líder na administração de shoppings no Brasil, com 32 empreendimentos. Em 2006, surge a brMalls resultando em um portfólio de 30 ativos presentes nas cinco regiões do país.

E assim, em 2023, a ALLOS surge com o encontro de duas potências nacionais do segmento, unindo forças para se tornar a mais inovadora plataforma de entretenimento, lifestyle, serviços e compras.

Nossa história continua e estamos prontos para criar momentos que transformam e impactam a vida das pessoas, gerando conexões e oportunidades.

Responsabilidades e atribuições:

  • Coordenar a equipe de SAC, recepção e Ambiência, visando a melhor experiência do cliente e a excelência em atendimento, tratando diretamente situações críticas de atendimento ao cliente e que necessitem de intervenção;
  • Coordenar a equipe do fraldário, proporcionando atendimento e ambientes agradáveis com excelência para aos clientes.
  • Acompanhar e analisar indicadores, bem como as pesquisas de NPS
  • Desenvolver e implementar políticas, procedimentos e diretrizes de qualidade em todas as áreas sob sua responsabilidade, incluindo, atendimento, limpeza, paisagismo, higiene alimentar, dedetização, gestão de resíduos e reciclagem, obras em lojas e reformas internas;
  • Gerenciar as atividades de equipes terceirizadas que prestam serviços essenciais para o shopping, como limpeza, HSA, asseio, paisagismo, gestão de resíduos, reciclagem, aromatização.
  • Garantir que os restaurantes e as operações de alimentação do shopping sigam rigorosamente os padrões de higiene alimentar da Anvisa, com o controle e gestão da consultoria terceira, que realiza um ciclo de inspeções e ações corretivas, notificando as lojas inadequadas quando necessário.
  • Manter e aperfeiçoar o padrão de reciclagem e boas práticas sustentáveis que o Shopping realiza, com o intuito de ampliar e estender o programa, a fim de desenvolver e implantar melhores práticas para minimizar o impacto ambiental do shopping e atingir e mata da companhia.
  • Coordenar projetos de reforma de ambientes internos do Shopping e supervisionar obras contratadas pela ALLOS. Gerenciar as Obras e reformas de lojas no shopping, garantindo que as obras sejam executadas de acordo com os padrões de qualidade estabelecidos e ocorram dentro do prazo programado.
  • Gerenciar e orientar equipe orgânica, garantindo que todos cumpram suas responsabilidades de forma eficaz.
  • Preparar relatórios de desempenho de qualidade e comunicar regularmente os resultados e problemas ao Gerente de Operações.
  • Garantir que o Shopping esteja em conformidade com todas as regulamentações e normas relevantes, incluindo as relacionadas à acessibilidade, segurança e higiene. Atentar aos prazos de vencimento de licenças e documentos.

title: Site Reliability Engineer
description:
About WSO2

Founded in 2005, WSO2 is the largest independent software vendor providing open-source API management, integration, and identity and access management (IAM) products. WSO2's products and platforms—including our next-gen internal developer platform, Choreo—empower organizations to leverage the full potential of APIs for secure delivery of digital services and applications, enabling thousands of enterprises in over 90 countries globally to drive their digital transformation journeys. Our open-source, API-first approach frees developers and architects from vendor lock-in, enabling rapid digital product creation. Recognized as leaders by industry analysts, WSO2 has over 800 employees worldwide with offices in Australia, Brazil, Germany, India, Sri Lanka, the UAE, the UK, and the US, with nearly USD100M in annual recurring revenue. Visit to learn more. Follow WSO2 on LinkedIn and X (formerly Twitter).

About the Role

As a Site Reliability Engineer at WSO2, you'll be instrumental in both supporting our existing customers with their managed or private cloud deployments and initiating new deployments across leading cloud platforms such as Azure, AWS, and GCP. Your mission will include ensuring the seamless operation, scalability, and security of WSO2 cloud services, alongside automating processes to boost both efficiency and reliability.

Your Key Responsibilities

  • Deployment Setup and Management:
  • Lead the design and implementation of new cloud deployments, tailoring solutions to meet stakeholder requirements on platforms like Azure, AWS, GCP, and Kubernetes.
  • Optimize cloud architectures for scalability and cost-effectiveness, adhering to best practices for networking, security, and access controls.
  • Gain and maintain deep knowledge of cloud infrastructure providers to create robust solutions.
  • Automation and CI/CD:
  • Craft and manage automation scripts and infrastructure as code (IaC) with Terraform, Ansible, or CloudFormation.
  • Deploy CI/CD pipelines to streamline software delivery, testing, and deployment processes, ensuring efficient version control and configuration management.
  • Managed Cloud Support:
  • Ensure the availability of the services by configuring system monitors and alerts and attending to critical alerts in a timely manner.
  • Offer continuous support and maintenance for existing deployments, monitoring system performance and swiftly resolving issues to maintain high availability and reliability.
  • Implement strategies for performance optimization and failure prevention, conducting thorough root cause analyses to avoid future issues.
  • Monitoring and Security:
  • Establish comprehensive monitoring and alerting systems to oversee customer deployments, setting thresholds for incident response.
  • Conduct regular security assessments and stay abreast of the latest threats and trends to fortify cloud environments against risks.
  • Collaboration and Knowledge Sharing:
  • Foster a collaborative environment with product developers, operations, and QA teams to enhance workflows and product quality.
  • Share knowledge and best practices, contributing to the team’s collective expertise through documentation, training, and mentorship.

Skills and Experience

  • Fluent in English.
  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent experience.
  • Expertise in cloud platforms such as Azure, AWS and GCP.
  • Expertise in Linux, virtualization and containerization technologies such as Docker and Kubernetes.
  • A solid understanding of networking, security principles, and compliance frameworks.
  • Proficiency in IaC tools (Terraform, CloudFormation), configuration management (Puppet, Chef, Helm), and scripting languages (Python, Bash, PowerShell).
  • Experience with CI/CD tools (Github Actions, Jenkins) and monitoring/logging tools (Prometheus, ELK stack, Splunk).
  • Exceptional problem-solving, analytical, and troubleshooting skills, coupled with a proactive, customer-centric mindset.
  • Strong communication skills and the ability to collaborate effectively in a team environment.

In Addition to a Competitive Compensation Package, WSO2 Offers:

  • A work culture and environment where we value both hard work AND flexibility.
  • A flexible vacation/leave plan that fits your needs.
  • Health, dental, and life insurance for you and your family.

Diversity Drives Innovation:

We've built our business on a commitment to diversity and inclusion. We believe it's important to foster an environment that values and respects each individual's strengths, perspectives, and ideas. Doing so not only drives innovation; it also ensures that we can create superior experiences for our customers, partners, and employees worldwide. We value the diversity of our team regardless of race, ethnicity, religion, gender, age, national origin, disability, sexual orientation, or veteran or marital status, and we do not tolerate any form of discrimination.

description:
Keeta, the international subsidiary of Meituan—the global delivery giant—is on a mission to revolutionise food and consumer product delivery worldwide. With our ongoing expansion into Saudi Arabia, Keeta achieved the remarkable feat of launching five cities in just 17 days, allowing the Arabic world to witness the speed of China. Keeta offers exciting opportunities to join a transformative journey that is shaping the future of delivery and retail. Join Keeta, explore the world.

What You'll Do:

  • Responsible for analyzing and formulating the expansion and operation plans for Brazil, addressing key supply-side issues of concern to management, and collaborating with relevant teams to align understanding and strategies;
  • Delve into the physical world to establish a comprehensive understanding of the local market, helping the business to clearly see the current state of restaurant supply in new markets (quantity, structure, profit/loss, etc.) and identify business opportunities;
  • Undertake other supply-side issues, conduct targeted thematic analysis, and provide data and strategy support for business decision-making.

What We Need From You:

  • Advanced proficiency in English and Portuguese;
  • Extensive work experience in business analysis and data analysis; experience in supply-side analysis and research is a plus;
  • Strong business acumen, with structured thinking and excellent research abilities, capable of deconstructing complex and ambiguous issues, conducting quantitative and qualitative verification, and proficient in data tools like SQL;
  • Quick learning ability, strong curiosity, and self-drive are important pluses;
  • Strong communication skills with experience in collaborating with various parties to advance projects;
  • Open-minded and willing to accept assignments in other countries.

What Makes This Role Exciting:

  • Participate in the growth of Brazil business from 0 to 1. 2.
  • Direct contact with the core business, establishing a comprehensive understanding of the food delivery industry and strengthening commercial analysis capabilities.

Why Join Keeta:

Keeta is redefining the future of food delivery with a clear vision and innovative spirit. As a fast-scaling brand under Meituan's global ambition, we offer a unique blend of stability and startup energy, providing boundless opportunities for personal and professional growth. Whether you want to specialize in your field or gain cross-functional experience, Keeta empowers you to take charge of your career.

As we expand globally, we are committed to building a workplace that reflects our unique culture while incorporating global best practices. You'll be part of a company that's transforming the delivery industry while supporting local communities, empowering merchants, and delivering outstanding customer experiences.

At Keeta, you'll collaborate with a passionate and pragmatic global team across over 94 countries, bringing diverse perspectives that drive creativity and innovation. We believe diversity is our strength and it pushes us to deliver better solutions for our customers and partners in Hong Kong, Saudi Arabia, and beyond.

Keeta offers limitless career growth and equal development opportunities, empowering you to grow as the company grows. Every day presents an opportunity for you to make a meaningful impact, grow professionally, and be part of something extraordinary. You'll thrive in a dynamic environment where every contribution is valued. Together, let's build the future of food delivery.

  • Develop and organize validation protocols, test plans, and quality checklists.

  • Collaborate cross-functionally with R&D, Engineering, Manufacturing, and Supply Chain during product development and transfer.

  • Maintain accurate records of test results, reports, and technical documentation.

Qualifications:

  • Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Quality, or a related technical field.
  • Solid knowledge and experience in quality management; hands-on experience in new product evaluation is strongly preferred.
  • Strong analytical and data interpretation skills; proficient in Excel and quality tools such as Six Sigma, SPC, QC methods, etc.
  • Effective communicator with strong organizational and stress management skills.
  • Fluent in English; proficiency in Portuguese and Chinese is a plus.
  • Customer-oriented, results-driven, resilient, and committed to integrity and continuous improvement.

工作内容：

  1. 负责新品及转产项目评价；
  2. 负责新品及转产项目测试项目制定及组织开展测试；
  3. 负责新品及转产项目问题闭环管理；
  4. 负责新品及转产项目品质要求转化。

任职资格

  1. 具备相关的学术背景和专业知识；
  2. 1-3年以上质量管理工作经验，从事过新品评价等相关工作经验优先；
  3. 语言：英语、葡萄牙语，汉语优先；
  4. 具备较好的数据分析和总结能力，熟练使用EXCEL函数，6Sigma、SPC、QC等；
  5. 具备良好的沟通能力，组织能力，抗压能力；客户&结果导向，正直、诚信、有韧性。

title: Engenheiro(a) de Dados Sênior
description:
Sobre a Avanti

A Avanti atua com originação e orquestração de crédito , conectando demanda a múltiplos parceiros financeiros. O modelo é performance-based (receita quando a operação efetiva).

Resumo da Posição Buscamos um(a) Engenheiro(a) de Dados Sênior para liderar o desenho e a implementação do nosso stack de dados ponta a ponta (do formulário ao contrato). Sua missão será garantir dados confiáveis, integrações sólidas de CRM e dashboards que reflitam fielmente a realidade da operação comercial.

Você será o(a) dono(a) técnico(a) dos pipelines entre HubSpot, ferramentas internas, mídia paga, WhatsApp e BI, resolvendo dores críticas como atribuição de marketing, governança de CRM e distribuição de leads. Trabalhará muito próximo aos times de Marketing, Vendas (Home, Auto, PJ) e Diretoria.

Principais Responsabilidades

  • Arquitetura e Pipelines:
  • Desenhar e implementar a arquitetura de dados (Data Lake/Warehouse, camadas de staging, data marts de vendas).
  • Construir e manter pipelines de dados (ETL/ELT) conectando: Site/Formulários, CRM (HubSpot), Mídia (Ads), Ferramentas internas/Parceiros (ex: C6, Creditas) e BI.
  • Qualidade e Governança:
  • Garantir a "Single Source of Truth" para indicadores comerciais (Leads, MQL, SQL, Receita, ROAS, CAC, LTV), eliminando conflitos entre dashboards.
  • Estruturar o Dicionário de Dados (regras de negócio, fórmulas de KPIs) e criar rotinas de monitoramento de qualidade (testes, alertas e reconciliação).
  • Apoio ao Negócio e Automação:
  • Integrar o CRM (HubSpot) com ferramentas de automação (WhatsApp, Zapier/Make, discadores), apoiando a governança de dados operacionais.
  • Criar camadas de dados para os funis de vendas (Home Equity, Auto, PJ) para identificar gargalos de conversão e crédito.
  • Apoiar a evolução do Lead Scoring , construindo a base de dados e tabelas que alimentam os modelos de pontuação.
  • Visualização e Mentoria:
  • Trabalhar com o time de BI para disponibilizar dados modelados prontos para consumo no Power BI/Looker Studio.
  • Orientar perfis mais juniores e estagiários em boas práticas de engenharia e governança.

Requisitos Obrigatórios

  • Experiência: 5+ anos como Engenheiro(a) de Dados, Analytics Engineer ou função similar.
  • Técnico: SQL avançado e forte experiência em modelagem de dados (OLAP, Star Schema, modelagem em camadas).
  • Engenharia: Experiência comprovada construindo pipelines em produção (Python e orquestradores como Airflow, dbt, Luigi, Fivetran, etc.).
  • Foco em Negócio (Essencial): Vivência com integração de CRM (HubSpot, Salesforce) e dados de mídia paga (Meta/Google Ads) para cálculo de ROI/ROAS.
  • Cloud & DW: Domínio de pelo menos uma cloud pública e DW moderno (BigQuery, Snowflake, Redshift, Azure Synapse).
  • Soft Skills: Capacidade de traduzir problemas de negócio em soluções técnicas e comunicar-se com áreas não técnicas (Vendas/Marketing).

Diferenciais Desejáveis

  • Experiência em Fintechs, mercado de crédito, bancos ou operações de Inside Sales intensas.
  • Familiaridade com ferramentas "Low-code" para integrações rápidas (Zapier, Make) e APIs de WhatsApp Business.

Remuneração, Benefícios & Modelo de Trabalho

  • Remuneração: negociada conforme o perfil (CLT ou PJ)..
  • Benefícios: VR via iFood, Wellhub e ambiente com alta autonomia.
  • Modelo: Híbrido em Americana–SP (3 dias presenciais/semana).

title: Senior Medical Advisor
description:
At Biocon Biologics, we are creating a model for the future of healthcare for all. We are a leading company in the biosimilars revolution where patients come first. Our ambition is to impact a billion lives and we do this by fostering a culture of affordable innovation, patient-centricity, and disruptive thinking. We are a multicultural global company where employees have a purpose and passion to work closely with partners and patients. We have a long-term commitment to bringing high-quality affordable biosimilars to patients all over the globe. We have proven end-to-end expertise from clone development, manufacturing, clinical development, and regulatory approvals to commercialization in developed and emerging markets.

Role: Sr Medical Advisor, Medical Affairs

Location- São Paulo, Brazil

We are seeking a candidate in Brazil Region as Medical Advisor within the Clinical Development and Medical Affairs organization. Reporting to the EM Head of Medical Affairs; the Medical Advisor will be involved in KOL engagement/ HCP interactions and provide Scientific support to KOLs /HCP to execute the core medico marketing strategies as well as support with Pharmacovigilance activities.

Responsibilities

  • Build a network of key opinion leaders through enhanced scientific interfaces and best practices
  • Engage and build robust relationships with HCPs, and KOLs on value, access, and pharmaco-economic areas, also seek advice on unmet needs for patients and other stakeholders
  • Develop/validate appropriate scientific content for conferences, briefing meetings & other policy-related activities/initiatives
  • Assist in the planning of new campaigns and launch activities
  • Be a brand ambassador for Biocon Biologics and its products
  • Safeguard patient benefit always through the application of relevant knowledge of science, regulations, and compliance in all initiatives undertaken by the organization
  • Prepare educational material/ videos/ website content/ patient information leaflets in collaboration with the medical affairs Centre of Excellence and marketing for relevant therapies.
  • Ideate evidence generation through IITs and registries in line with strategy, addressing concerns/feedback from the HCPs, patients, and other stakeholders
  • Author publications/blogs/white papers related to the value and differentiation of our products
  • Collaborate with the training team in updating and reviewing slide decks/manuals and other relevant materials
  • Promote patient centricity within Biocon Biologics
  • Provide valid scientific responses to all the medical queries from the customers regarding the products and therapy area involved
  • Promote diversity & inclusion in clinical trials, and data and get involved in ESG objectives as it pertains to medical affairs
  • Together with the global teams, formulate meaningful real-world evidence studies, and support clinical strategy and execution related to registration and post-registration clinical trials.
  • “Responsible for local Pharmacovigilance communications for the Pharmacovigilance System of the Registration Holder of Medicament
  • To have oversight of the Pharmacovigilance system of the PRH/MAH in terms of structure and performance and to ensure directly or through supervision that the system components and processes are in place.
  • Thorough understanding of the safety profiles of the products under the responsibility of the Medication Registration Holder
  • Reside in Brazilian territory and be available to attend PV-related requirements and inspections.
  • Promote inclusions and suggestions in the Risk Management Plans and Periodic Benefit-Risk Assessment Reports
  • Ensure adequate and timely submission of expedited adverse reaction reports, PBRERs and other safety reports to the regulatory agencies as per applicable local regulations.
  • To have oversight on weekly literature searches and to report the valid ICSRs to the regulatory agency in the territory as per the applicable regulations.
  • To alert the Authority of any emerging safety issue(s) involving registered products. ”

Other basic requirements include:

  • Ability to interact with senior internal and external personnel
  • Attention to detail and taking accountability
  • Ability to work across more than a few therapy areas
  • Create sense of purpose and inspiration in the team
  • Must be able to work in a team environment, working closely with cross-functional teams
  • Collaborate with medical affairs colleagues in other countries/regions and share knowledge and learnings
  • Functional expertise in MS office, Veeva Vault
  • Substantial knowledge and understanding of policies, procedures, and guidelines relevant to medical affairs operations
  • Substantial knowledge of HCP policies and regulations
  • Proven understanding of the needs of individuals living with cancer and chronic diseases like diabetes or other autoimmune diseases as well as pressing public health issues, including at the pharmacy and HCP levels.

Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree required; advanced degree preferred (e.g., MS, Pharm D, Ph.D., or MD);
  • Minimum 05 years of medical affairs, patient access, and advocacy experience in the biopharmaceutical, or relevant non-profit or payer industry.
  • Must be willing and able to travel (approximately 30%) regionally, including to other countries within the EM region.

Biocon Biologics is an Equal Opportunity, EEO / Affirmative Action Employer committed to excellence through diversity. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to, and no employee shall be discriminated against because of their race, color, religion, age, sex (including pregnancy), national origin, disability, genetic information, status as a protected veteran or any other characteristic protected by applicable federal, state or local law.

description:

title: Corporate Legal - Associate
description:
About the Company

Credit Saison Brazil (“CSBR”) is part of Credit Saison Group, which has Credit Saison Co. Ltd. (Japan) as ultimate parent and Saison International (Singapore) as its international headquarter. Our core businesses are lending operation and equity investment consisting of early-stage start-up investment and M&A/joint venture.

Founded in 1951, Credit Saison Co. Ltd., is one of Japan’s largest non-bank financial corporations listed on Tokyo Stock Exchange. Outside Japan, over 1,000 talented employees are working across global markets because of Credit Saison's dedication to foster an environment of diversity, collaboration, inclusion and career growth. The group has a mission to bring people, partners and technology together, delivering resilient and innovative financial solutions for positive impact.

Established in 2023, CSBR primarily provides credit solutions in Brazilian private debt market to support the innovators as a transformative partner in contributing to financial inclusion. So, if you're passionate about making positive impacts in the finance sector while working in a multi-cultural environment, we want to hear from you. Join us on this exciting journey, where your talent can make a meaningful difference and together, let's contribute to the future of finance in Brazil.

About the Role

  • Prepare drafts, review and independently negotiate documents of different areas and variable complexity (such as NDAs, service agreement, engagement letters, software related agreements, employment agreements, head-hunter agreements, lease agreements) ensuring compliance with legal framework, identifying potential risks and providing acceptable mitigation suggestions in a timely manner.
  • Analyze, organize and align comments and changes in contracts reviews with external counsels, key internal and international stakeholders, including the Global Legal & Compliance.
  • Conduct legal research on relevant regulations and case law to support decision making, ensuring contract terms and corporate alignment with latest legal developments and internal policies.
  • Provide, jointly with the corporate legal team, tailored legal advice across multiple areas such as corporate governance, labor, tax, civil law and regulatory (including Central Bank matters), ensuring strategic alignment with business objectives and regulatory requirements.
  • Draft, review and coordinate the execution of corporate resolutions, ensuring that all legally and governance-required elements are accurately reflected in the minutes, while also managing with third party service providers, under the Corporate Legal Manager’s supervision: (i) submissions to the Central Bank and registrations with the Board of Trade; and (ii) registration of the minutes in corporate books, in accordance with local corporate regulation.
  • Enhancing internal legal processes, developing standardized templates and implementing best practices to increase efficiency in both legal analysis and compliance.
  • Lead, under the Corporate Legal’s Manager supervision, specific projects related to license application to Central Bank, compliance with LGPD (Lei Geral de Proteção de Dados), corporate and tax structuring initiatives.
  • Coordinating cross-functional legal initiatives, preparing materials, improving reporting structures and weekly routines with stakeholders;
  • Coordinate requests for documents to international stakeholders, receipt, translation, notarization and registry with local external counsels and paralegals, in accordance with local regulations.
  • Support the Corporate Legal team by establishing routines to monitor legal updates, sharing relevant information with key stakeholders, assessing potential impacts on the company’s business, and proposing and implementing appropriate solutions.
  • Support knowledge sharing and internal development initiatives through the preparation of materials or participation in training activities

Requirements

  • 6 - 7 years of post-qualification experience as a Lawyer (preferably some experience working as in-house counsel), strong general profile, desirable experience with corporate, civil, labor and regulatory (Central Bank) law;
  • Bachelor's degree in law;
  • Duly registered with the Brazilian Bar Association (OAB);
  • Strong ability to manage priorities;
  • Good organization and proactive profile;
  • Clear and objective communication skills for interaction with diverse internal and external stakeholders;
  • Fluency in English (written and spoken);
  • Excellent legal technical skills and strong attention to detail;
  • Solid interpersonal and collaborative abilities.

title: Senior Instrumentation Engineer - (Relocation to Saudi Arabia is required)
description:
Role : Senior Instrumentation Engineer

Job Description:

We are seeking an Instrumentation Engineer with extensive experience in Instrumentation utilized for the final control, monitoring and safety of Gas Plants, NGL Fractionation Plants, Refineries, petrochemicals plants, Pipelines and Distribution facilities, to join the Process Automation and Systems Division, which is part of the Process & Control Systems Department.

Process and Control Systems Department provides services in the field of process engineering, automation, new energy, and digitalization to various entities within Aramco.

As an Instrumentation Engineer your primary role will be to provide instrumentation engineering expertise to the various Aramco entities including designing, developing, installing, and troubleshooting. You will work with different disciplines such as operating sites, instrumentation engineering, facility planning, and project management. Additionally, you are expected to participate in the organization and company initiatives including safety programs, innovation programs, operational excellence, knowledge sharing, self-development and other programs as required.

Key Responsibilities:

As a successful candidate you will be required to perform the following:

  • Provide support with all types of instrumentation including but not limited level, temperature, pressure, control valves, Emergency Isolation Valves, Motor Operated Valve, Relief Valves, flow measurement, level gauges etc.
  • Originate and carries out engineering studies to determine optimal solutions to complex technical problems, increase revenue, reduce cost, and improve process safety.
  • Works with and/or leads Task teams assigned to investigate incidents or solve specific technical problems.
  • Undertakes special assignments requiring extensive technical experience and discretion when dealing with outside organizations.
  • Develops and maintains Saudi Aramco Engineering Standards, Material Specifications, Procedures and Best Practices to enhance company profitability, safety, and productivity by applying and interpreting key industry codes and standards relevant to instrumentation and control.
  • Reviews and evaluates capabilities of vendors and contractors to determine their acceptability to perform major services to Saudi Aramco.
  • Acts as a Company representative in technical dealings with vendors, manufacturers, and design firms.
  • Perform technical evaluation for instrumentation quotations and attend technical bid evaluation meetings.
  • Evaluates and introduces best practices and new technologies to enable the Company to achieve Best in Class performance in oil and gas business.
  • Performs cost analyses and Value Engineering studies to recommend cost-effective solutions to technical issues.

Minimum Requirements:

As a successful candidate you will be required to perform the following:

  • Bachelor’s degree in Engineering preferably in Instrumentation, Mechanical or Electrical engineering. A Master's degree or PhD in Engineering is desired but not required.
  • Minimum 20 years of professional experience as an engineer in charge of technical work in field of specialty. Previous work with a major international Oil & Gas Company and/or previous employment with one of the Instrumentation suppliers used by Company is desired.
  • Must have experience in plant instrumentation sizing and selection (Control valves, Pressure Relief valves, Actuators, Basic Process Measurement etc.)
  • Certified in ISA- Certified Automation Professional (CAP), Certified Functional Safety Professional (CFSP), TUV FSEng, Principles & Practice of Engineering (PE) certification, or Chartered Engineer (C.E.) license or registration.
  • Basic knowledge of H2S, LEL, pH, conductivity, O2 analyzer, CO/CO2 analyzer, fire & gas detectors and Gas chromatographs is preferred.
  • Proficiency in the International codes and standards used within the oil and gas industry, i.e., API, BS, ISO, ASME, ANSI, IEC, ISA, IEEE, etc.
  • Have participated as lead engineer in HAZOP, SIL, P&ID, Design, and model reviews.
  • Understanding of control systems, compressor and pumps field instrumentation, speed controllers, Vibration Monitoring Systems (VMS), Compressor Control Systems (CCS).
  • Understanding communication protocols like DNP3, Modbus, FieldBus, TCP, IEC, SPA, RP570, ANSI and General Process Automation Protocols.
  • Have been an active member in a relevant professional society, (i.e., ISA, IEEE, etc.) for a minimum of 3 years and have been holding current membership.

title: Senior .Net Developer
description:
Job Title: Senior Software Engineer (Contractor)

Job Type: Full-time (Remote)

Pay: R$20,000.00 – R$22,000.00 per month

Position Overview

We are seeking a Senior Software Engineer contractor to join our U.S.-based team remotely. You will leverage your technical expertise to deliver high-quality code for moderately to highly complex projects.

In this role, you will work on our healthcare platform, gaining deep system knowledge and contributing to our Agile workflow via Azure DevOps . You will begin with automated testing and peer reviews , expanding into broader development tasks by months 2–3. Your role will evolve based on your strengths and our needs — all while adhering to rigorous coding and security standards .

Key Responsibilities

1. Product Design & Development

  • Collaborate with stakeholders to design software solutions aligned with technical and business objectives.
  • Write, optimize, and maintain efficient code, including enhancing existing codebases (opportunities starting around months 3–4).

2. Testing & Quality

  • Design and implement automated End-to-End (E2E) tests (e.g., using Microsoft Playwright) to ensure feature stability — with a strong focus during your first 6–9 months.

3. Peer Reviews & Post-Release Support

  • Participate in pre-release feature reviews (ongoing).
  • Conduct initial post-release bug ticket analysis (first 90 days), transitioning to broader ownership over time.

4. Agile Collaboration

  • Actively contribute to 2-week sprints and 6-week release cycles (3 sprints per release).
  • Participate in sprint planning, pull requests, releases, and daily stand-ups (3:00 PM CT).

5. Communication & Coordination

  • Collaborate effectively with technical and non-technical team members across time zones.

Qualifications

Experience

  • 8 years of software engineering experience, with a proven track record on complex projects.

Technical Skills

  • Proficiency in C# ASP.NET (.NET 8) for web applications and APIs.
  • Experience with .NET MAUI and Blazor Web Application (.NET 8) for mobile and web development.
  • Familiarity with Microsoft Azure (Azure App Service, Azure SQL, Azure Storage).
  • Proficient with modern development tools (Visual Studio, Git, Azure DevOps).
  • Knowledge of secure coding practices and cybersecurity principles.
  • Experience with cloud platforms and Agile methodologies.

Soft Skills

  • Excellent problem-solving and analytical abilities.
  • Strong communication skills for remote collaboration.
  • Ability to work independently and within a collaborative team.

Preferred

  • Familiarity with healthcare software or Protected Health Information standards (e.g., HIPAA).
  • Experience with pull request reviews and sprint participation.

How We Work

  • Agile Workflow: 2-week sprints, 6-week release cycles, daily stand-ups at 3:00 PM CT.
  • Code Standards: Strict adherence to best practices, peer reviews, and security testing (e.g., OWASP, Detectify).
  • Tools: Azure DevOps, Visual Studio, SQL Server Management Studio, Datadog, Microsoft Playwright, and more.
  • Team Culture: Accountability, quality, and excellence in delivery.

title: Corretor de imóveis
description:
Resumo do Cargo

O Corretor de Imóveis parceiro da Apolar Jardim Botânico é um profissional dinâmico e proativo, responsável pela comercialização de imóveis prontos (usados) e lançamentos em Curitiba e Região Metropolitana.

Como ter sucesso no cargo: O sucesso nesta função é impulsionado pela capacidade de entender e antecipar as necessidades dos clientes, oferecendo soluções imobiliárias que geram valor. Isso inclui uma gestão eficiente de leads de diversas fontes, um uso exemplar das ferramentas tecnológicas, e uma participação ativa na angariação de novos imóveis para a carteira. Profissionais que se destacam são aqueles que cultivam relações de confiança, dominam as técnicas de negociação, e mantêm-se atualizados sobre o mercado imobiliário e as condições de financiamento. A colaboração com a equipe e o alinhamento com os objetivos da franquia são diferenciais para alcançar o sucesso.

Responsabilidades
  • Angariar Imóveis: Identificar e angariar ativamente imóveis (usados e lançamentos) na região de Curitiba e Região Metropolitana, expandindo o portfólio da franquia e visando atingir a meta de 100 imóveis em carteira.
  • Gestão de Leads: Gerenciar e qualificar leads provenientes de diversas fontes (portais de anúncio, anúncios patrocinados, portal da Rede Apolar, LAIS), realizando o primeiro contato, acompanhamento e nutrição para convertê-los em clientes qualificados.
  • Uso de CRM: Determinar e desenvolver requisitos de usuários para sistemas em produção (Apolar Sales), garantindo o preenchimento completo e organizado de todas as informações de clientes, imóveis e interações, otimizando o fluxo de trabalho.
  • Atendimento ao Cliente: Realizar atendimento consultivo e personalizado, compreendendo a real necessidade do cliente, apresentando as opções de imóveis mais adequadas e conduzindo visitas de forma eficaz.
  • Negociação e Fechamento: Conduzir processos de negociação de compra e venda, elaboração de propostas e acompanhamento de contratos, garantindo a segurança e transparência em todas as etapas da transação.
  • Colaboração com a Equipe: Colaborar ativamente com a equipe de corretores, gerência e franqueados parceiros, compartilhando informações de mercado, estratégias e melhores práticas para otimização dos resultados coletivos.
  • Avaliação de Imóveis: Colaborar no processo de avaliação de imóveis quando solicitado, utilizando o conhecimento de mercado e, se certificado, o registro no CNAI.
  • Conhecimento de Mercado: Manter-se atualizado/a sobre as tendências do mercado imobiliário de Curitiba, novas legislações, condições de financiamento e o perfil de cada bairro para oferecer um serviço consultivo de excelência.
Qualificações
  • Formação: Ensino Médio completo. Curso superior, é um diferencial, mas não obrigatório.
  • Registro Profissional: Possuir registro ativo no Conselho Regional de Corretores de Imóveis (CRECI).
  • Experiência: Experiência prévia comprovada na comercialização de imóveis, com preferência para atuação em imóveis usados e/ou lançamentos.
  • Competências de Comunicação: Excelentes competências de comunicação oral e escrita, com clareza, persuasão e habilidade para se comunicar por telefone e WhatsApp.
  • Habilidade Tecnológica: Familiaridade e disposição para utilizar ferramentas de CRM (Apolar Sales) e outras tecnologias para gestão de leads, acompanhamento de processos e organização de informações.
  • Proatividade e Resiliência: Capacidade de agir com proatividade na busca por resultados e na angariação de imóveis, além de resiliência para lidar com objeções e desafios do mercado.
  • Orientação para o Cliente: Forte orientação para o cliente, com foco em entender suas necessidades, construir relacionamentos de confiança e proporcionar uma experiência de compra positiva.
  • Organização: Boa capacidade de organização e atenção aos detalhes para manter registros precisos e acompanhar múltiplos processos simultaneamente.
  • Infraestrutura: Possuir carro, notebook, acesso à internet fora do escritório e celular para desempenho das atividades.

title: Gerente de Recursos Humanos
description:
No Grupo Iberostar estamos à procura de um profissional para atuar como Gerente de Recursos Humanos para se juntar à nossa equipe em Praia do Forte (Bahia) . Antes de saber mais sobre a vaga, achamos relevante compartilhar algumas informações sobre o Grupo Iberostar:

  • Somos uma empresa 100% familiar (mais concretamente, uma família de mais de 30.000 colaboradores).
  • Estamos presentes em 35 países e a nossa sede é em Palma de Maiorca.
  • Os nossos valores (Paixão, Responsabilidade, Transparência, Criatividade e Humildade) são muito importantes para nós e todas as nossas ações estão alinhadas com eles.
  • Somos pioneiros no turismo sustentável (veja o nosso movimento Wave of Change para saber mais).

Se isto lhe parece interessante... este pode ser o lugar certo para você! :)

Missão global da função: Gerencia a equipe nas atividades referentes aos subsistemas de Recursos Humanos, responsável pelo planejamento, organização e gestão de Transporte Fretado, Benefícios, Programas de Reconhecimento, Programa de Estágio, Jovem Aprendiz e PCD, atração de talentos, cargos e salários, recrutamento e seleção, desenvolvimento de liderança, treinamento e desenvolvimento, gestão de conflitos, onboarding, análise de desligamentos, gestão de resultados por meio da elaboração de relatórios gerenciais e indicadores de desempenho a fim de garantir a fluidez, padronização e adequação dos subprocessos, alinhado com os valores, visão e missão do Iberostar.

Quais serão suas principais funções?

  • Define estratégias gerais para atração de talentos, definindo os meios de comunicação mais adequados e redes de relacionamento, a fim de atrair candidatos para o processo seletivo.
  • Revisa se as solicitações de pessoal encaminhadas atendem às políticas e procedimentos do Iberostar, a fim de fundamentar pareceres à Diretoria sobre novas contratações.
  • Gerencia o preenchimento dos cargos vagos em tempo hábil, de acordo com a Política de Atração de Talentos.
  • Gerencia e elabora projeto de qualificação de mão-de-obra local visando maximizar a produtividade e a qualidade do atendimento ao hóspede.
  • Gerencia e acompanha o Programa de Estágio, verificando o cumprimento das atividades previstas no plano de estágio, estabelecendo relacionamento com o agente integrador, visando alcançar os objetivos do programa.
  • Gerencia e acompanha o Programa de Indução dos novos funcionários, a fim de facilitar a adaptação dos recém-contratados.
  • Atende os colaboradores em processo de desligamento, se necessário.
  • Analisa as justificativas apresentadas pelo gestor e possibilidades de reaproveitamento a fim de gerenciar o turnover da empresa.
  • Administra a estrutura de cargos e salários do Iberostar, sugerindo alterações salariais, a fim de oferecer condições necessárias para a definição de uma política de remuneração competitiva frente ao segmento.
  • Apoia a Gerência Executiva no desenvolvimento de normas e procedimentos que estabeleçam estruturas de cargos e salários equitativas e justas na organização, visando ampliar a flexibilidade de movimentação de pessoal.
  • Analisa a criação e/ou extinção de cargos, validando o complemento das Competências Específicas conforme práticas do mercado, políticas e normas do Iberostar, visando subsidiar os demais subsistemas de Recursos Humanos com as descrições atualizadas.
  • Gerencia, acompanha e orienta à equipe na elaboração do plano anual de treinamento de pessoal, realizando diagnóstico de necessidades de desenvolvimento de competências, propondo orçamento específico, a fim de submeter à aprovação da Diretoria.
  • Gerencia e acompanha as atividades de treinamento, confrontando capacitações com as atribuições e objetivos das áreas solicitantes, identificando resultados de aprendizagem e de desenvolvimento profissional, verificando o cumprimento das programações estabelecidas no plano anual, a fim de atender às necessidades de formação e desenvolvimento de competências.
  • Gerencia o processo de avaliação de desempenho da organização, acompanhando e interferindo em todas as fases do processo, a fim de obter resultados precisos e satisfatórios tanto para o colaborador como para a organização.
  • Desenvolve estratégias para melhoria do clima organizacional, identificando falhas e implantando inovações e processos motivacionais, visando à integração e alinhamento das ações dos colaboradores aos valores do Iberostar. Além de coordenar a aplicação da Pesquisa de Clima Global.
  • Desenvolve estratégias de Endomarketing, identificando oportunidades de engajamento dos colaboradores, definindo instrumentos e canais de comunicação, a fim de fazer com que a comunicação certa chegue de forma eficaz ao destinatário.
  • Define e acompanha as campanhas e ações internas de Recursos Humanos.
  • Gestiona e controla a operação e custos do Transporte Fretado.
  • Gestiona e controla o plano de benefícios para colaboradores.
  • Executa outras tarefas correlatas ao cargo, a critério do seu superior imediato.

O que é necessário para ter sucesso nesta função?

  • Capacidade de Análise e Síntese
  • Negociação
  • Planejamento e Organização
  • Senso Estratégico
  • Planejamento Estratégico
  • Gestão de Custos
  • Idioma Espanhol ou disponibilidade para cursar de imediato
  • Utilização de pacote Google Sheet

Alguns dos nossos benefícios:

  • Trabalhar em um ambiente inspirador que aposta nas pessoas, nos valores e em um modelo de turismo responsável.
  • Pacote de remuneração competitivo, com benefícios atrativos.
  • Oportunidade de progressão dentro da empresa: uma variedade de oportunidades e projetos que permitirão desenvolver seu potencial e crescer profissionalmente

title: Specialist - External Quality Assurance
description:
Specialist – External Quality Assurance

São Paulo, Brazil / Remote

Nexcella, Inc.

Our 3 Core Values

• Intelligence

• Integrity

• Initiative

Our mission is to harness the immune system through innovative cell therapies and other modalities to deliver widely accessible cures. Patients are waiting!

What You'll Do:

The Specialist, External Quality Assurance (EQA) will provide oversight of Contract Development and Manufacturing Organizations (CDMOs) and testing laboratories to ensure compliance with cGMP, regulatory requirements, and company quality standards. This role is critical in supporting ongoing manufacturing campaigns, batch release, and ensuring timely resolution of quality events.

What We Look For:

Key Responsibilities

  • Review and approve deviations, Out-of-Specification (OOS) investigations, CAPAs, and change controls from CDMOs and external testing laboratories.
  • Monitor manufacturing campaigns, production activities, and resolve issues during routine manufacturing.
  • Review and approve QC/analytical results and Certificates of Analysis from CDMOs/external labs.
  • Review and approve production lot records for compliance prior to disposition.
  • Perform GMP reviews of incoming documentation (batch records, test data, release packages).
  • Ensure timely escalation and resolution of manufacturing and quality issues.
  • Collaborate with internal cross-functional teams (QA, QC, Supply Chain, Regulatory, CMC) to ensure readiness for release and regulatory filings.
  • Support audit readiness activities for Regulatory Authority inspections.

Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in Life Sciences, Chemistry, Biochemistry, Engineering, or related discipline.
  • 3 - 5 years of QA experience in the biopharmaceutical or cell/gene therapy industry.
  • Strong knowledge of cGMP, ICH Q7/Q10, FDA 21 CFR Parts 210/211.
  • Experience with CDMO oversight, lot release, and deviation management.
  • Excellent communication and problem-solving skills.

About Nexcella, Inc.

Nexcella, Inc. is a subsidiary of Immix Biopharma, Inc. (ImmixBio) (Nasdaq: IMMX), a clinical-stage biopharmaceutical company developing cell therapies for AL Amyloidosis and other serious diseases. Our lead candidate is sterically-optimized BCMA-targeted chimeric antigen receptor T (CAR-T) cell therapy NXC-201 with a “digital filter” that filters out non-specific activation. NXC-201 is being evaluated in the U.S. multi-center study for relapsed/refractory AL Amyloidosis NEXICART-2 (NCT ), with a registrational design. Interim results were presented at ASCO 2025. title: Analista de Engenharia
description:
A Unimed BH

Somos a Unimed-BH, uma das melhores operadoras de planos de saúde do Brasil. Há mais de 50 anos, nosso propósito é cuidar da saúde, e esse cuidado se traduz em inovação contínua, qualidade com custo acessível, ética e sustentabilidade para oferecer o melhor serviço aos nossos mais de 1.500.000 de clientes.

O nosso compromisso é proporcionar um ambiente pautado pelo respeito, pelo acolhimento e pela valorização ao nosso time de mais de 10 mil profissionais, entre colaboradores administrativos, assistenciais e médicos cooperados.

Todas as nossas oportunidades também são destinadas a pessoas com deficiência, pessoas de todas as orientações sexuais e identidades de gênero, de diferentes raças e etnias, e idades, sem qualquer tipo de distinção.

Acreditamos que agilidade e simplicidade são a melhor forma de trabalhar e estamos sempre prontos para sugerir novas soluções para serviços e produtos, afinal, a inovação está no nosso DNA, o que nos leva a inspirar nossos colaboradores a atuarmos juntos, como um só time, com foco do cliente.

Para isso, oferecemos um ambiente propício ao desenvolvimento e benefícios atrativos de mercado. Esperamos você para seguirmos juntos cuidando da saúde!

É necessário que tenha:

  • Ensino superior completo em Engenharia Civil, Elétrica ou Mecânica;
  • CREA ativo;
  • Experiência sólida em acompanhamento em obras;
  • Conhecimento em gestão e planejamento de projeto;
  • Conhecimento avançado de leitura de projeto e intermediário para AUTOCAD;
  • Desejável Técnico Engenharia Civil;
  • Conhecimentos intermediário no Pacote Office (Word, Excel, Power Point).

Como será seu dia a dia:

  • Apoiar na elaboração dos escopos de serviços de engenharia considerando as melhores práticas da engenharia, atendendo as demandas internas das unidades hospitalares, clínicas e administrativas;
  • Apoiar na elaboração de estudos de viabilidade técnica, análise orçamentária e elaboração de escopos de contratação
  • Realizar apresentações de orçamentos e projetos, para futuras demandas solicitadas pelas Unidades dentro da cooperativa.
  • Apoiar no planejamento estratégico, para redução dos riscos existentes nas atividades de obras e reformas em ambientes hospitalares e administrativos, ambos em funcionamento.
  • Acompanhar o processo de contratação do fornecedor, sejam para obras e/ou projetos de engenharia, dando apoio nas dúvidas levantadas, visitas técnicas e equalização técnica das propostas.
  • Fiscalizar a execução dos serviços, sejam para obras e/ou projetos de engenharia, apoiando o contratado na interface com a unidade e fazendo reportes periódicos para as lideranças imediata e da unidade atendida, visando pleno atendimento da qualidade, prazo e custo.
  • Propor melhorias contínuas no processo de execução do serviço, sejam de obras e/ou projetos de engenharia, visando o ganho de prazo, o aumento da qualidade e o corte de custos.
  • Buscar novas oportunidades de melhoria nas instalações/estrutura hospitalar, apontando e enviando para o coordenador de engenharia fazer a análise de aplicação.
  • Apoiar na gestão do avanço físico e financeiro dos serviços contratados, conferência dos boletins de medição sobre os serviços executados no período
  • Reportar ao superior imediato os andamentos dos projetos, desvios, medidas de mitigação, melhorias etc, para apoio tomada de decisão por parte das lideranças.
  • Coletar os requisitos técnicos e funcionais de todas as áreas envolvidas no projeto para incorporação no projeto e certificação do atendimento das normas de saúde vigentes.
  • Apoiar na realização dos relatórios de acompanhamento, gerenciamento e fiscalização das obras contratadas, bem como dos contratos de projetistas e na a emissão dos relatórios de check list e entrega final de obra.

Horário e Local de Trabalho:

  • Horário 8hs às 18hs - Modalidade: Presencial.
  • Local: BH e Região Metropolitana.

A Unimed-BH respeita a diversidade e inclusão em todas as suas vagas. Sem distinção de gênero, orientação sexual, raça, religião ou deficiência.

Identificou-se com os requisitos? Clique em "Candidatura Simplificada" e faça a sua inscrição! No portal de vagas da Unimed-BH, você encontra essa e outras oportunidades da Cooperativa. Acesse vagas.unimedbh.com.br e faça parte do nosso time.
